full_text_tesim: References to folios from ms. Georgian NF 55 added to show the actual distribution
The folios represent remnants of six quires (quaternions) of the original codex which comprised the complete Gospel of John

This UTO is connected to the Gospel of John UTO in Sinai Georgian NF M 55. The original quires formed the first unit of a composite codex containing the five quires of the Caucasian Albanian Lectionary as its second unit
